article.title: The civil war in France
article.author: Vijay Prashad
article.content: Students in the Paris suburbs came onto the streets merely to get teachers into their classrooms, to have enough desks for their classmates, and to have the state build school buildings fit for the educational experience. The post The civil war in France appeared first on MR Online .
